# New poll tracker shows Donald Trump's approval rating by state. See where Washington stands

Portrait of Zachary Fletcher Zachary Fletcher

Kitsap Sun

Oct. 7, 2026, 9:54 a.m. PT

President Donald Trump's approval rating plummeted in a majority of states - including Washington - with just under four weeks remaining until voters head to the polls in the 2026 midterm elections. [...] Nationally, the Civiqs tracker found that 60% of Americans nationwide disapprove of Trump, 34% approve and 6% neither approve nor disapprove. Civiqs recorded over 134,600 responses between January 2025 and October 2026 to compile the polling data.
